whatItDoes: Marc Anthony Strictly Curls 3X Moisture Triple Blend Conditioner 250ml hydrates and detangles curly hair, reducing frizz for soft, defined curls.
pros: Infused with marula oil, coconut cream and shea butter, it restores moisture, strengthens hair and protects against environmental stressors.
With 3X moisture, no strand is left behind.
Strictly Curls 3X Moisture is formulated with a triple blend of marula oil, coconut and shea butter.
It gives thirsty curls the essential moisture they need to feel strengthened, smoothed and protected.
